text: im confused it still doesnt work the way you say it should. im on terrain, im on square brush, water, flat, -9.5 height and im painting. im not expecting it to show up on the 2d like you said. its still not there on the 3d
resolution: Root cause of the water brush painting nothing: the level was Math.max(0, centerZ), and the user was painting with the height slider at -9.5, which clamps to 0 (dry) so no wet cells were ever written — hence nothing in 2D or 3D. The slider's sign is meant for digging terrain; for a water SURFACE a negative is meaningless. Changed the level to max(1, |centerZ|) so any slider value paints visible water (-9.5 becomes a 9.5 m surface) and the brush never silently no-ops; erase still clears to dry. One-line fix in stampWaterAtGraph.
